fr-core-v1.description: A short starter set: everyday nouns, a few key verbs and the words that link sentences, with grammar pages for them.

fr-foundations-v1.description: For a complete beginner. Greetings, the verbs you need first, numbers and time, family, food, the body and finding your way in town.

fr-everyday-v1.description: After A1. Daily routines, weather and seasons, clothes, travel, work, the doctor and shopping, plus short spoken replies.

fr-fluency-v1.description: After A2. Opinions, society and history, everyday idioms, false friends and the French people speak.
